title: ‘Frozen 3’ Stars Kristen Bell, Idina Menzel & Josh Gad Tease New Music at D23
summary: The third installment in Disney’s hit franchise will hit theaters in November 2027.
body: Frozen 3 is officially underway, and excitement is already snowballing over the franchise’s new music. The third installment of Disney’s blockbuster franchise was announced Friday (Aug. 14) at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event in Anaheim, California, where stars Kristen Bell , Idina Menzel and Josh Gad reunited onstage to tease new music ahead of the animated film’s 2027 theatrical release. title: Dave Marsh, Influential Critic, Activist, Broadcaster & Biographer of Bruce Springsteen, Dies at 76
summary: “A tireless advocate of justice, human rights and rock ’n’ roll,” Tom Morello wrote.
body: Dave Marsh, one of the most influential music writers of his generation and a passionate activist for health care, social justice and freedom of expression, died on Friday (Aug 14). The cause of his death has not been reported but he had been in declining health in recent years. Related Gone But Not Forgotten: Musicians We Lost in 2026 Courtney Love Says She 'Almost Died' in 2019 Slipknot Cuts Ties With Sid Wilson After Nearly 30 Years Born in Pontiac, Michigan, in 1950, Dave grew up immersed in the sounds of Detroit — Motown, R&B, and rock ‘n’ roll — inspiring a lifelong belief in the power of music. Marsh was among the first editors of Creem magazine when it launched in 1969. He wrote extensively for Rolling Stone and other publications and authored more than two dozen books on artists including Elvis Presley , The Who and Bruce Springsteen . His 1979 biography, Born to Run: The Bruce Springsteen Story , became a New York Times bestseller. In 1993, Marsh shared a Grammy for best album notes for Aretha Franklin’s Queen of Soul. title: Bonnie Tyler Fans Line Welsh Village Streets as Her Coffin Is Brought Home
summary: The “Total Eclipse of the Heart” singer died in July at age 75.
body: Hundreds of fans lined the streets of a seaside Welsh village on Saturday (Aug. 15) to bid farewell to late singer Bonnie Tyler as her coffin was brought home. The Grammy-nominated Welsh pop star, beloved worldwide for her 1983 chart-topping power ballad “Total Eclipse of the Heart,” died last month in a hospital in Portugal. She was 75. Related Bonnie Tyler’s Billboard Chart Legacy: ‘Total Eclipse of the Heart’ & Beyond Forever No. 1: Bonnie Tyler’s ‘Total Eclipse of the Heart’ Bonnie Tyler, ‘Total Eclipse of the Heart’ Singer, Dies at 75 Tyler was hospitalized in May in Faro, where she had a home, for emergency intestinal surgery. Locals and fans from around the United Kingdom and beyond took to the streets of Mumbles, near the city of Swansea, to see the hearse, which carried her coffin, draped in a Welsh flag. Dozens waited outside the singer’s former home or left floral tributes there. “She was always coming home and making sure that she came back to her fans in Wales,” said Carys Edwards, 18. “Her songs really did touch a lot of people here in Wales; we loved her a lot.” Tyler was born Gaynor Hopkins, a coal miner’s daughter in public hou…

title: Romeo Santos Launches Fundación Los Santos to Support Children With Autism & More Uplifting Moments in Latin Music
summary: Plus, Eladio Carrión brings Saucegiving back to Puerto Rico, and Rosalía honors Caetano Veloso and Fito Páez in Rio.
body: From career milestones to new releases to major announcements and those little important moments,  Billboard  editors highlight  uplifting moments  in Latin music. Here’s what happened in the Latin music world this week. Romeo Santos Launches Fundación Los Santos to Support Children With Autism Romeo Santos is turning a very personal experience into a broader mission. On Tuesday (Aug. 11), the bachata superstar announced the launch of Fundación Los Santos, a registered 501(c)(3) organization created to support children with autism and their families through greater access to resources, educational opportunities, developmental programs and community initiatives. “As a father of a child with autism, I have experienced firsthand both the joys and challenges that many families face every day,” Santos said in a statement. “The Los Santos Foundation seeks to help families feel seen, supported and empowered, contributing to a more hopeful future for so many children.” With a personal contribution from Santos, the foundation’s initial efforts will focus on grants, strategic partnerships, family resource centers, social and developmental opportunities for children,…

title: Here Are Events Marc Anthony, Feid, Karol G & More Latin Music Artists Are Joining in Support of Colombia and Venezuela Earthquake Relief
summary: Benefit concerts are set to take place during the weekend of Aug. 15-16.
body: While Colombia grapples with the aftermath of its highest-magnitude earthquake recorded in the 21st century, the music industry is mobilizing to support relief efforts. Artists in the United States and Colombia are joining forces, using their influence and music to raise funds for organizations and communities that need support in rebuilding cities and assisting families in need.  Related Everything You Need to Know About the Unidos Por Los Nuestros Benefit Concert: Donations, Artists & How to Watch How to Help Those Impacted by the Earthquakes in Colombia Shakira, Maluma, Camilo & More Bring Attention to Earthquake in Colombia: ‘We Need Strength and Union’ Colombian artists including Maluma, Karol G, Feid and Carlos Vives and artists from other countries such as Puerto Rico, Cuba and Venezuela are participating in events and fundraisers, or simply using their nonprofits and social media for visibility and assistance as Colombia and Venezuela recover from devastating earthquakes. title: Billboard’s Music Industry Events Calendar
summary: A complete rundown of the most important events across the music business.
body: As part of our continuing efforts to serve the music industry and its creators, Billboard Pro now features a music industry events calendar for readers. The calendar will act as music’s most complete summary major national and international industry events, from conferences to festivals to networking mixers and more. Just as Billboard is music’s must-read source for news, charts and analysis, now it also is the go-to for business happenings.
